name: ojs-mcp
description: MCP server for the authenticated Open Journal Systems REST API (OJS 3.5/3.6)
long_description:
Queries the REST API of any OJS instance: issues, articles, submissions, publications, and controlled vocabularies, with pagination and hyperlink following. Writing data is disabled by default.

The instance address must be provided below — it has no default value on purpose. Every OJS deployment is a different journal, so a hard-coded host would mean silently showing someone else's data as your own.

base_url.title: OJS instance address
base_url.description: The journal's base address — exactly as it works in the browser, e.g. https://journals.your-university.edu (without /index.php and without a journal name at the end). The server won't start without this.

journal.title: Journal shortcut (optional)
journal.description: The path segment from the journal's OJS address — for .../index.php/my-magazine that's "my-magazine". Needed only when this OJS instance serves more than one journal; leave empty for a single-journal instance.

api_token.title: OJS API token
api_token.description: The token from your OJS profile: logged-in user → "API Key" tab in your profile → enable third-party application access → copy the generated key. Needed for operations beyond publicly available data.
